children: Chancellor John Healey is set to announce a £150m fund for companies in the north of England as part of a wider plan to boost UK economic growth, according to BBC. The money, drawn from funds already allocated to the British Business Bank, will offer investments of between £5m and £15m for the most innovative and fast-growing firms, including university spin-outs and other ambitious businesses.

Healey is expected to say public investment can unlock private capital, support the innovation economy and create jobs in the regions. The speech comes ahead of his first Budget on 28 October, against a backdrop of higher government borrowing costs and concerns about the inflationary impact of the Iran war.

title: Chancellor To Unveil £150m Fund For Northern Firms
